newsitem.title: USA: Zenith National acquires workers' comp plan.
newsitem.headline: Zenith National acquires workers' comp plan.

text.p: Zenith National Insurance Corp said its Zenith Insurance Co unit has agreed to acquire all the assets and workers' compensation insurance business from RISCORP Inc.
Zenith also will acquire RISCORP's existing in-force insurance business, the right to new and renewal policies, and its "First Call" managed care workers' compensation system.

In a statement issued late Tuesday, Zenith said it would pay the difference between the book value of purchased assets and the book value of assumed liabilities. The deal is subject to a minimum purchase price of $35 million, payable in cash.
Zenith said it will fund the purchase with bank financing and internal funds.
After the deal closes, RISCORP will no longer engage in the workers' compensation or managed care businesses.
Zenith and RISCORP have also entered into an agreement under which all new and renewal RISCORP policies issued after Tuesday will be reinsured by Zenith.
Finally, Zenith said it will not acquire the stock of RISCORP or its affiliates or assume their corporate liabilities.
